include(c_oracle.cmake)  # the pre-flip C as <target>_c: python -m rustconv.c_oracle

# testgui.exe is all Rust (testgui-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/testgui-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# testgui.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/testgui-rust/src/testgui/testgui.rs)
add_cargo_module(testgui testgui-cargo testgui.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE testgui-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32)
